# crosswork_collection_jobs_cadence (Resource)

This resource can manage the cadence of the Crosswork collection jobs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_collection_jobs_cadence" "example" {
  reachability_check = 600
  snmp_check         = 1200
  te_tunnel_id       = 1200
  show_clock         = 1800
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `reachability_check` (Number) Seconds between two reachability checks of the devices, 300 (5 minutes) to 86400 (24 hours). Leave it unset to keep the value the cluster holds
  - Range: `300`-`86400`
- `show_clock` (Number) Seconds between two collections of the clock of the devices (`show clock`), 600 (10 minutes) to 86400 (24 hours). Leave it unset to keep the value the cluster holds
  - Range: `600`-`86400`
- `snmp_check` (Number) Seconds between two SNMP checks of the devices, 600 (10 minutes) to 86400 (24 hours). Leave it unset to keep the value the cluster holds
  - Range: `600`-`86400`
- `te_tunnel_id` (Number) Seconds between two collections of the TE tunnel ids, 600 (10 minutes) to 86400 (24 hours). Leave it unset to keep the value the cluster holds
  - Range: `600`-`86400`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_collection_jobs_cadence.example "collection_jobs_cadence"
```
